programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: A Ronda Wildfire tem três chefs executivos acesos e prontos para grelhar. Na Ronda Crossfire, um chef é espremido e os juízes sentam-se para um banquete muito requintado e beijado pelas chamas.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: A Ronda Wildfire começa com três chefs a lutar contra o tempo e os elementos, para assegurarem um lugar na Ronda Crossfire. O júri serve um desafio de grelhados e o chef sobrevivente enfrenta um lendário mestre do churrasco num banquete de inspiração portuguesa!

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 14
programme.desc: Neste Ó da Casa, Joana fecha o ciclo de projetos para os diferentes espaços da sua casa com duas peças incríveis e indispensáveis para quem gosta de desfrutar de momentos de descanso e de convívio no jardim - um cadeirão e uma lareira de exterior.

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T4 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: O Scott ajuda um casal a melhorar a sua propriedade de férias para arrendar com resultados espetaculares.

programme.title: Pastelaria Para Todos T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Em Pastelaria para Todos, aprenderá a realizar uma multiplicidade de sobremesas elaboradas por Carlos Fernandes. Desde os petiscos mais doces e tradicionais. O jovem pasteleiro ensina a dominar uma infinidade de técnicas para que todos possam desfrutar das iguarias de pastelaria em casa.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Ana Arrebentinha desafiou o Chef Chakall a preparar 2 receitas com os seguintes ingredientes: ovos, melão e pão. Chakall cozinhou Gaspacho de Melão e Migas com Polvo com Molho de Melão e Manga. Será que superou o desafio?

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Pedro Fernandes desafiou o Chef Chakall a preparar 2 receitas com os seguintes ingredientes: cuscuz, mel e coco ralado. Chakall cozinhou Caril da Rita e Cuscuz Doce. Será que superou o desafio?

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T2 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: O mundo da joalharia é pura inspiração, também para Sofia que nos apresenta três projetos que os valorizam: um toucador, um espelho de fibras naturais e um organizador de brincos. A criatividade e a mistura de materiais e técnicas serão a chave para o sucesso.

programme.title: Personaliza A Tua Casa T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: A madeira é um material perfeito para modelar móveis de exterior. Neste caso, Sofia ensina-nos a criar uma espreguiçadeira, um jardim vertical e uma mesa de apoio com os materiais que já temos. Três projetos fáceis e muito originais para fazer em casa.

programme.title: Plantmania - Ep. 12
programme.desc: Uma casa acabada de remodelar, em que a Carolina e o Daniel arregaçaram as mangas para realizar os seus sonhos. Mas houve um que ficou em pausa: encher a sua casinha de verdinhas. Está na hora de conhecer este simpático ‘’casalinho’’, mestres do ‘’DiY’’!

programme.title: A Ilha Do Bryan T4 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: À medida que vão fazendo progressos na sua casa na Florida, Bryan e Sarah têm ideias diferentes sobre as suas vidas depois do hotel. Bryan faz uma viagem inesperada.

programme.title: Experiências.PT T1 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: Uma experiência todo-o-terreno espera João Kopke em Pinhel. Ao percorrer a região por percursos alternativos, vão surgir várias descobertas...

programme.title: Prova De Amizade T2 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: A chef Marlene e o chef João testam a sua ligação musical para descobrirem quem são os convidados neste episódio. Os chefs optam por um menu internacional que acreditam agradar a Rita da Nova e Guilherme Fonseca.

programme.title: Prova De Amizade T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: A descoberta dos convidados deste jantar passa por resgatar pistas que estão dentro de balões que têm de ser rebentados de formas inusitadas. Depois de algumas pistas, percebem que os convidados são Diogo Batáguas e Vítor Sá, amantes de bem comer.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Mary Adora Sopa. Junte-se à obsessão pelas sopas com receitas que variam entre o acolhedor e o fresco, aveludadas ou com pedaços, além de uma dose generosa de queijo, claro.

programme.title: As Receitas Simples De Mary T3 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Coalhada de feijão, mais conhecida como tofu! Ou seja, o substituto de carne mais comum para os vegetarianos por aí fora. Mas as novas ideias da Mary para o tofu não têm nada de comum.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T2 - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes põe mãos à obra para preparar umas Gambas com Manga para Vanessa Oliveira. Numa conversa sem tabus, a convidada aborda a relação com o corpo e com a alimentação, refletindo sobre os desafios da maternidade e a exigência de conciliar essa faceta com a sua profissão.

programme.title: Aqui Há Sabor T2 - Ep. 9
programme.desc: Fátima Lopes vai ao encontro do chef Salvador Horta e Costa, ou Shippyboy, para lhe preparar um reconfortante Arroz de Polvo. Habituado a trabalhar os melhores produtos do oceano, Salvador partilhando a sua profunda paixão pela gastronomia e a sua ligação umbilical ao mar.

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Remodelações No Jardim T2 - Ep. 4
programme.desc: Tammy e Sam estão tão ocupados que o quintal ficou abandonado e os dois filhos já não o utilizam.

programme.title: Mudanças Na Casa De Família - Ep. 4

programme.title: Constrói O Teu Castelo T2 - Ep. 27

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T3 - Ep. 13

programme.desc: Nicole, Charles e os três filhos já não cabem na casa, e as festas do bairro são demasiado grandes para o alpendre.

programme.title: Fire Masters T1 - Ep. 14

programme.title: Ó Da Casa T1 - Ep. 15

programme.title: A Casa De Férias Do Scott T4 - Ep. 9

O jovem pasteleiro ensina a dominar uma infinidade de técnicas para que todos possam desfrutar das iguarias de pastelaria em casa.

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 9

programme.title: Os Amigos Do Chef T1 - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Tio Jel desafiou o Chef Chakall a preparar 2 receitas com os seguintes ingredientes: Batata doce, robalo e banana. Chakall cozinhou Tiradito de Robalo com Muita Calma e Robalinho Crostado com Esparregado. Será que superou o desafio?

programme.title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá T1 - Ep. 1

programme.title: Toma Lá, Dá Cá T1 - Ep. 2

programme.title: Plantmania - Ep. 13

É, sem dúvida, um projeto desafiante, não só pela sua dimensão, mas porque queremos trazer para este espaço plantas que a Sara e família consigam cuidar. E claro deixar toda a vizinhança roída de inveja hehe…plantmanas, aqui vamos nós!

programme.title: Rupture: Superando O Medo
programme.desc: Renée Morgan é uma mãe solteira que tenta libertar-se a todo o custo da organização misteriosa que a raptou e mantém presa e que a usa como cobaia de horríveis experiências.

programme.title: Crimson Peak - A Colina Vermelha
programme.desc: Quando o seu coração é roubado por um estranho sedutor, uma jovem é levada para uma casa no topo de uma colina de argila vermelha: um lugar repleto de segredos que a assombrarão para sempre. Entre o desejo e a escuridão, o mistério e a loucura, encontra-se a verdade por detrás de Crimson Peak.

programme.title: A Presença Maligna
programme.desc: Uma médica do exército britânico volta da guerra e pensa que sofre de stress pós-traumático quando o que descobre é que afinal existe um espírito maligno assustador que ameaça transformar por completo a sua vida.

programme.title: Por Amor…
programme.desc: Walter é uma estrela em ascensão do wrestling universitário cuja irmã é brutalmente assassinada. Ao regressar à cidade natal, conhece uma mulher mais velha cujo marido também foi assassinado e a dor que partilham acaba por aproximá-los inesperadamente.

programme.title: O Amor E A Vida Real
programme.desc: Dan Burns é um colunista, especialista em aconselhamento familiar, mas com dificuldade em sobreviver como irmão e como pai viúvo de três filhas precoces. As coisas tornam-se ainda mais complicadas quando Dan descobre que a sua apaixonada secreta é na realidade a nova namorada do irmão…

programme.title: Pureza
programme.desc: Nos anos 90, uma mãe procura o seu filho desaparecido e descobre fazendas com práticas de trabalho escravo na região da Amazónia.

programme.title: Assalto Inesperado
programme.desc: Quando um ladrão invade uma casa para um assalto, dá de caras com uma rapariga a meio de uma tentativa de suicídio. O que começa por ser uma aventura, rapidamente se transforma numa comédia romântica sobre duas pessoas que acabam por salvar-se uma à outra.

programme.title: A Partida
programme.desc: Ben e a sua melhor amiga Tanner resolvem pregar uma partida à professora de Física que ameaça reprová-los, acusando-a falsamente nas redes sociais do homicídio de um estudante.

programme.title: Marnie
programme.desc: Uma jovem cleptomaníaca usa identidades falsas para roubar empresas. Quando o patrão descobre a fraude, força-a ao casamento — e tenta desvendar o trauma profundo que ela esconde e que a domina desde criança.

programme.title: Os Empatas
programme.desc: Quando três pais ficam a saber que as suas filhas fizeram um pacto entre si para perderem a virgindade no baile de finalistas, eles iniciam uma missão secreta para boicotarem os seus planos.

programme.title: Fortaleza
programme.desc: Robert vive numa espécie de estância natural criada para oficiais reformados dos serviços secretos dos EUA. Quando um grupo de criminosos invade o complexo com intenções de o matar, ele vai ter de encontrar um modo de proteger as vidas de todos os que lá se encontram.

programme.title: O Reino Secreto
programme.desc: Os jovens irmãos Peter e Verity lançam-se na missão mágica de unir cinco tesouros místicos para derrotar um inimigo ancestral e salvar uma terra encantada, cheia de criaturas fantásticas.

programme.title: Mães À Solta
programme.desc: Quando três mães atoladas em tarefas e pouco apreciadas em casa atingem todos os limites, resolvem deixar para trás as responsabilidades que habitualmente assumem e aproveitar uma liberdade e uma diversão que, se calhar, até pode fazer delas melhores mães.

programme.title: Rosalie
programme.desc: Em 1870, Rosalie é uma jovem que esconde um segredo: ela tem barba, que oculta com receio de ser rejeitada pela sociedade. Quando Abel casa com ela, ainda desconhece esse facto, só que ela quer deixar de ocultar essa realidade e passar a ser vista e amada tal como realmente é.

programme.title: Haymaker
programme.desc: Nick, um ex-lutador tailandês de Muay Thai, perde o emprego como segurança quando defende uma cantora transexual de um agressor, e acaba por ser contratado como guarda-costas dela, acabando depois por regressar aos ringues.

programme.title: A Memória De Um Assassino
programme.desc: Alex Lewis é um assassino profissional que se recusa a completar a missão de matar uma criança, o que o torna num alvo a abater. A sua única hipótese é perseguir aqueles que o querem matar, só que ele tem um desafio quase inultrapassável: está a perder a memória a um ritmo cada vez mais acelerado.

programme.title: Suspeita De Traição
programme.desc: Uma advogada está a construir um caso contra um homem suspeito de ser um “serial-killer”. Apesar de ignorar as ameaças de morte que recebe, tudo muda quando o marido desaparece, ela é chantageada e acaba por pedir ajuda ao ex-marido, um detetive de homicídios com a carreira suspensa.

programme.title: Marnie
programme.desc: Uma jovem cleptomaníaca usa identidades falsas para roubar empresas. Quando o patrão descobre a fraude, força-a ao casamento — e tenta desvendar o trauma profundo que ela esconde e que a domina desde criança.

programme.title: All Styles - Ao Ritmo Da Dança
programme.desc: Um jovem adepto do hip-hop é rejeitado pela antiga equipa de dança por ir para a faculdade antes de uma competição importante. Como resultado, ele junta um grupo heterogéneo de dançarinos para enfrentar o seu antigo grupo e ganhar 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: As Aventuras De Lia
programme.desc: Lia é uma órfã jovem e perspicaz que vive nas ruas da Cidade da Névoa. Um belo dia, disfarça-se de princesa e acaba por embarcar numa delirante missão de salvamento de Rolando, o herdeiro do trono que foi enfeitiçado e transformado num... galigato (metade galinha, metade gato).

programme.title: Sete Noivas Para Sete Irmãos
programme.desc: No Oregon de 1850, Adam Pontipee, um rude lenhador, casa com a jovem Milly e leva-a para a quinta onde vivem os seus seis irmãos, de modos muito selvagens, que também decidem casar mas que, inspirados pelo rapto das Sabinas, acabam por raptar seis raparigas da cidade.

programme.title: Mune - O Guardião Da Lua
programme.desc: Num mundo mítico, Mune surpreende toda a gente ao ser nomeado guardião da lua, com a missão de trazer a noite e tomar conta do mundo dos sonhos. Mas uma série de desastres dá a oportunidade ao guardião da escuridão, de roubar o sol. Conseguirá Mune resolver a situação?

programme.title: Ivanhoe
programme.desc: Regressado das Cruzadas, o cavaleiro Ivanhoe luta para resgatar o rei Ricardo Coração de Leão e travar a tirania do príncipe João, entre torneios, traições e um amor impossível, numa grande epopeia medieval de honra e coragem.

programme.title: Bigfoot Júnior
programme.desc: Adam, um rapaz de 13 anos, embarca numa épica aventura para descobrir o mistério que envolve o seu pai, desaparecido desde sempre. Ao chegar à floresta, todos os animais o reconhecem como filho do lendário Bigfoot, pelo seu cabelo fora do normal e pés com vida própria que saltam dos sapatos.

programme.title: Missão Inesperada
programme.desc: Jim Hanson, um ex-atirador de elite do exército, vive junto à isolada fronteira entre os EUA e o México e torna-se inesperadamente o protetor de um menino mexicano, quando um perigoso cartel de droga mata a mãe do rapaz e os começa a perseguir de forma implacável.

programme.title: After
programme.desc: Tessa, uma rapariga bem-comportada de dezoito anos, conhece na faculdade Hardin, um rapaz rude e rico com um passado sombrio, por quem se apaixona e com o qual perde a virgindade. Os dois embarcam numa relação turbulenta e intensa, que os mudará para sempre.

programme.title: Eliminators: Fugir Ou Morrer
programme.desc: Um antigo agente federal tem de abandonar o programa de proteção de testemunhas quando a sua casa é invadida por engano. Quando volta a ser perseguido por um perigoso assassino, tem de fugir com a filha e garantir a sua segurança antes de ser apanhado!

programme.title: Ascensão De Júpiter
programme.desc: Jupiter Jones é uma jovem empregada de limpeza que encontra um dia Caine, um ex-militar interplanetário geneticamente manipulado, e descobre que ela é a herdeira de uma família da nobreza intergalactica e que tem de proteger os habitantes da Terra de uma ameaça antiga e destrutiva.

programme.title: Tudo Bons Rapazes
programme.desc: Desde que era miúdo, nos anos 50, que Henry Hill queria ser um gangster. Ao longo das décadas seguintes, ele conseguiu cumprir o seu sonho e fazer parte de uma das mais importantes famílias criminosas de Nova Iorque. Só que o preço a pagar seria demasiado alto.

programme.title: Traficados
programme.desc: Trazido para Los Angeles para fazer um tratamento, um viciado em recuperação descobre rapidamente que o centro de reabilitação não serve apenas para ajudar pessoas, mas é uma operação fraudulenta multimilionária que recruta viciados que recrutem outros viciados.

programme.title: Tribute to Hans van Manen
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills. In this tribute to the great choreographer, dancers of the Dutch National Ballet perform three masterpieces from Van Manen’s extensive oeuvre.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Zubin Mehta
programme.desc: Indian conductor Zubin Mehta (1936) became Music Director of the Israel Philharmonic Orchestra (IPO) in 1977 and was appointed Music Director for Life in 1981. On July 18, 1996, Mehta led the IPO in its first-ever performance of Richard Strauss’s tone poem Till Eulenspiegels lustige Streiche, Op. 28.

programme.title: Verdi - Rigoletto
programme.desc: Riccardo Frizza leads the Orchestra and Chorus of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s tragic opera Rigoletto (1851). In 1850, Teatro La Fenice commissioned Verdi to compose a new opera. Verdi proposed Victor Hugo’s controversial play Le Roi s'amuse to his librettist Francesco Maria Piave.

programme.title: Schumann - Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz presents Schumann’s Piano Sonata No. 2 in G minor, Op. 22. The composer completed the work in 1838. Of Schumann’s three piano sonatas, Piano Sonata No. 2 is performed and recorded most frequently.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1, Op. 15
programme.desc: Confusing as it may be: Ludwig van Beethoven’s Second Piano Concerto was in fact composed ten years prior to his First Piano Concerto. The cause of this mess lies with the composer himself: Beethoven held back the publication of what we know as the Second Piano Concerto until after that of the First Piano Concerto, so he could thoroughly review the piece.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartets No. 2, 14 And 16
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mendelssohn - Trio No. 1 Op. 49
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich, violinist Tedi Papavrami and cellist Mischa Maisky perform Felix Mendelssohn’s Piano Trio No. 1 in D minor, Op. 49.

programme.title: Heavenly Voices - The legacy of Farinelli
programme.desc: The documentary 'Heavenly Voices – The Legacy of Farinelli' (2012) tells us the story of the castrato in music – male singers who were castrated at a young age in order to preserve their high vocal range, a cruel practice that was in place mainly in the 17th and 18th centuries.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn And Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Mozart - Requiem in D minor, K. 626
programme.desc: Daniel Harding leads the Orchestra and Choir of the Maggio Musicale Fiorentino and four vocal soloists in a magnificent performance of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart’s Requiem in D minor, K. 626. The soloists are soprano Christiane Karg, mezzosoprano Sara Mingardo, tenor Matthew Swensen, and bass Gianluca Buratto. The Austrian Count Walsegg commissioned Mozart to compose a Requiem in July 1791 to commemorate his late wife, Anna.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, Op. 73
programme.desc: The Berliner Philharmoniker, Daniel Barenboim and Claudio Abbado star at the Europakonzert 1994 in Meiningen, Germany, performing Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 and Johannes Brahms’ Symphony No. 2. Popularly known as the Emperor Concerto and composed in Vienna between 1809 and 1811, Piano Concerto No. 5 is Beethoven’s last completed piano concerto and often performed by star pianists such as Daniel Barenboim.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 5
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Fantasymphony - One Concert to Rule Them All
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra opens the door to a wealth of fantasy universes in this mesmerizing concert program.

programme.title: Copland - Appalachian Spring
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Aaron Copland’s Appalachian Spring Suite. Originally commissioned as a ballet for the legendary dancer Martha Graham, Aaron Copland's Appalachian Spring (1944) has since become an American classic. While first scored for a thirteen-piece ensemble, Copland later arranged the work for a full orchestra.

programme.title: Barbarian Nights
programme.desc: Barbarian Nights is the second oeuvre of choreographer Hervé Koubi with twelve Algerian and Burkinan dancers, selected on an audition in Algeria in 2009.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 7 And 13, and Op. 133
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous 'hammer' blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: Ravel - La Valse
programme.desc: The exceptional Russian pianists Nikolay Lugansky and Vadim Rudenko join forces in a performance of Maurice Ravel’s La Valse, in an arrangement for two pianos. This performance was recorded at the Tchaikovsky Concert Hall in Moscow, Russia, on November 25, 2021.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage.

programme.title: Bruckner - Symphony No. 7
programme.desc: In a 2019 performance from the Muziekgebouw in Eindhoven, Hartmut Haenchen conducts the philharmonie zuidnederland for this performance of Anton Bruckner’s Symphony No. 7.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Wagner - Das Rheingold
programme.desc: Hartmut Haenchen conducts the Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra and Dutch National Opera in a production of Richard Wagner's opera Das Rheingold, the first opera of the four-part cycle 'Der Ring des Nibelungen'. Richard Wagner, perhaps the greatest innovator of the opera genre in the nineteenth century, aimed for the creation of a ‘Gesamtkunstwerk’ in which theatre, music and words are united.

programme.title: Works by Mozart and Sarti
programme.desc: Italian conductor Mattia Rondelli conducts the Orchestra dell’Opera Carlo Felice Genova in a concert program consisting of works by Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart and Giuseppe Sarti. Soprano Barbara Massaro is the soloist. On the program are Mozart’s Symphony No. 5 in B-flat major, K.

programme.title: Approaching the Maelström
programme.desc: The 2019 documentary ‘Approaching the Maelström’ follows the process leading up to a recording of American composer Philip Glass’s composition ‘A Descent into the Maelström’. The work is based on American writer Edgar Allan Poe’s 1841 short story of two fishermen caught in torrents raging between the mountainous islands of Lofoten, Norway.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l’Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven’s symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven’s Symphony No. 4 in B-flat major, Op. 60. Count Franz von Oppersdorff adored Beethoven’s Symphony No. 2 and offered the composer a large sum to write a similar work. Beethoven obliged and completed his Symphony No. 4 in the autumn of 1806.

programme.title: Schubert - Rondo D. 951
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists. As part of this concert, Argerich and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï perform Franz Schubert’s Rondo in A major, D. 951.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Beethoven - Last Sonatas, Op. 109, 110 And 111
programme.desc: Beethoven’s last three sonatas – Opus 109, 110 and 111 – explore the intimate meanders of the human soul, from despair to transfiguration. At the time of their composition, Beethoven was already locked in himself by his deafness. This deeply affected his relationship to others and to the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 And Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. programme.title: Shostakovich - Concertino for two pianos
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: The Three Lives of Clara Schumann
programme.desc: The documentary “The Three Lives of Clara Schumann” traces the fascinating life story of German pianist and composer Clara Schumann. Born Clara Wieck in Leipzig in 1819, she was an exceptionally talented pianist, with an impressive international music career. She first met Robert Schumann, whom she married in 1840 and eventually had eight children with, in 1828.

programme.title: Chopin - Polonaise-fantaisie, Op. 61
programme.desc: Ukrainian-born pianist Inna Faliks performs Frederic Chopin's Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61. Recorded at the Nicols Concert Hall, Evanston, IL, USA. Faliks has established herself as one of the most communicative, and poetic artists of her generation. The Polonaise-Fantaise was dedicated to Mme A. Veyret, composed and published in 1846.

programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 6
programme.desc: On November 14, 1987, a promising conductor made his Berlin Philharmonic debut with Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 6: Simon Rattle. In retrospect Rattle says, “I felt that I was finding my voice on that day.” Mahler’s multifaceted work is now again on the program when Sir Simon appears for the last time as chief conductor of the Berliner Philharmoniker in the Philharmonie in 2018. The wheel comes full circle. Mahler's Symphony No.

programme.title: Chamber music by Haydn, Tchaikovsky and others
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of ‘Preludio’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. The program opens with Joseph Haydn’s Concerto in D major for cello and orchestra, H VIIb: 2 (cello and piano reduction), performed by cellist Alejandro Gómez Pareja and pianist Miguel Ángel Ortega Chavaldas.

programme.title: Hans van Manen – Moving to Music
programme.desc: Dutch choreographer Hans van Manen (1932) is internationally recognized as one of the grand masters of contemporary ballet. His over 150 ballets all bear his distinct signature, featuring a great clarity in structure, refined simplicity and an aversion to decorative frills.

programme.title: Bach - Violin Sonata No. 3 (BWV 1005)
programme.desc: Celebrated German violinist Isabelle Faust performs J. S. Bach’s Sonata No. 3 in C major (BWV 1005). The work is part of the composer’s well-known Sonatas and Partitas for Solo Violin (BWV 1001-1006). Sonata No. 3 includes an extensive fugue in which Bach employs many contrapuntal techniques. In this wonderful performance, Faust shows her mastery of Bach’s technically challenging piece. This performance was recorded at St.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 8
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 8, also known as the 'Symphony of a Thousand,' is a monumental choral epic composed in 1906 that requires an enormous ensemble of soloists, choruses, and a massive orchestra to perform its vast musical tapestry. The work is a unique and grandiose tribute to love and the spiritual salvation of mankind, drawing from two distinct textual sources to create its sublime effect.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concertos, BWV 1046-1051
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 1 in D major
programme.desc: Mexican conductor Carlos Miguel Prieto leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s Symphony No. 1 in D major, “Titan”. Composed between 1887 and 1888, the symphony blends traditional form with innovative ideas like folk melodies, march rhythms, and fanfare motifs.

programme.title: Liszt - Due Poemi Sinfonici
programme.desc: Franz Liszt (1811 - 1886) composed 13 symphonic poems, largely inspired by literary texts. The composer himself wrote piano duet arrangements for these pieces, showcasing his incredible ability of imitating a full orchestra on the piano. Liszt, one of the 19th century’s most important piano virtuosos, strongly influenced the further development of piano music.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 2, Op. 36
programme.desc: In this concert at the Lucerne Festival, Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt leads the Lucerne Festival Orchestra in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Martha Argerich – A Birthday Celebration III
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored chamber music repertoire in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Lily Maisky and Iddo Bar-Shaï, violinists Tedi Papavrami and Akiko Suwanai, her daughter Lyda Chen-Argerich on viola, and cellist Mischa Maisky.

programme.title: Orff - Carmina Burana
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name.

programme.title: Cartoons in Concert
programme.desc: It's going to be fast, really fast! All your favourite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the Concert Hall - together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras. Cartoons are for children and adults alike - and the music in them is at least as entertaining as the pictures!

programme.title: Schumann - Fantasie in C, Op. 17
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Schumann composed his Fantasie in C, Op. 17 in 1836, revising it prior to publication in 1839.

programme.title: Tales of Two Cities: Leipzig-Damascus Coffee House
programme.desc: The Tafelmusik Baroque Orchestra also known simply as Tafelmusik, is a Toronto-based Canadian baroque orchestra, specialised in early music. Its musical director is Jeanne Lamon. Together with the Trio Arabica they celebrate the music and culture in the eighteenth century.

programme.title: Brahms Tragic Overture And Mahler Symphony No. 1
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète
programme.desc: The documentary “Clara Haskil - Le mystère de l’interprète” (2017) tells the remarkable life story of Romanian pianist Clara Haskil (1895-1960). Born in Bucharest into a Jewish family, she began her career as a child prodigy, entering the Bucharest Conservatory at a very young age. She continued her music studies in Vienna and Paris. Haskil suffered from chronic health issues and lived through two world wars, which held back her career.

programme.title: Liga D’Ouro - Ep. 261
programme.desc: As emoções do futebol jogam se todos os dias. Todas as novidades dos grandes do futebol a caminho de mais uma jornada de golos, polémicas, alegrias e tristezas para Benfica, Sporting e Porto.

programme.title: Jornal Da Meia-Noite
programme.desc: Cobertura intensiva da atualidade, em direto, com reportagem e análise da atualidade e dos exclusivos com a marca da CMTV.

programme.title: Noite Das Estrelas

programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Segure Minha Mão T1 - Ep. 110
programme.desc: A história gira em torno de uma garota chamada Azra, que está estudando no exterior, na América, para se tornar cozinheira profissional, assim como seu pai.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 13
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 40
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Nova Oportunidade T1 - Ep. 98
programme.desc: NOVA OPORTUNIDADE é uma nova série dramática ambiciosa e de grande sucesso, com algumas das maiores estrelas da Turquia. A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Círculo - Ep. 59
programme.desc: Dois jovens, Cihangir e Kaan, são atraídos para um jogo mortal gerido por uma organização criminosa chamada O Círculo. Trocados à nascença por líderes da máfia, crescem sem conhecer as suas verdadeiras identidades. Anos mais tarde, os seus caminhos voltam a cruzar-se enquanto lutam pela justiça e pelo amor, enredados numa teia de segredos, traição e poder.

Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: O Jogo do Destino - Ep. 42
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

programme.title: Meu Campeão - Ep. 61
programme.desc: Kafkas, um jovem pugilista promissor, tem sua vida virada de cabeça para baixo com um infeliz incidente que o força a abandonar a carreira e se despedir dos ringues. Anos depois, ele retornará ao ringue por seu filho Günes e ficará por mais um assalto.

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T1 - Ep. 15
programme.desc: Ressurreição conta a história da tribo Kayi, uma das tribos turcas que se afastaram das estepes da Ásia Central e que chegou aos territórios da Anatólia. Ertugrul, que tem os seus objetivos, e não tem medo de morrer pela sua religião, pela sua terra natal e pela sua família, luta contra o poder imperial do seu tempo com uma estrutura inteligente e visionária.

programme.title: Charlie Haden And Orchestra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: G.B. 4, Red N., D.G. Band, D.B. 4 - Newport Jazz
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Brazilian NYE
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is Paulo Novaes.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Barbara
programme.desc: Legendary jazz pianist Horace Silver's groundbreaking fusion of hard bop, blues, soulful grooves and Cape Verdean influences have left an indelible mark on the world of jazz. At the renowned Umbria Jazz Festival in the picturesque region of Umbria, Italy, Silver is accompanied by a great band of future all-stars: Bob Berg on tenor sax, Tom Harrell on trumpet, Steve Beskrone on bass and Eddie Gladden on drums.

programme.title: Tribute to Gilberto Gil - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is Caixa Cubo.

programme.title: Live in London 2015
programme.desc: The Apple Music Festival (formerly known as the iTunes Festival) was a music concert series held by Apple, Inc. inaugurated in 2007.

programme.title: Avishai Cohen/Robert Sadin, Puncha Puncha
programme.desc: Double bassist Avishai Cohen’s trio with Noam David (drums) and Omri Mor (pianist) joined forces with the international Symphony Orchestra ‘INSO-Lviv’, conducted by Christian Schumann. On June 24, 2017 they brought Avishai Cohen’s signature blend of influences from Eastern Europe, American jazz and the Middle East to the Alfa Jazz Festival in Lviv, Ukraine.

programme.title: Gregory Porter - Jazz a Vienne
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne’ is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2012 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was vocalist Gregory Porter transcends the jazz bubble.

programme.title: Sammy Davis Jr. - Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On May 28, 1967, American singer and actor Sammy Davis Jr. appeared at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam for a live, nationwide TV broadcast. Supported by his band conducted by George Rhodes, Davis Jr.

programme.title: Bobby McFerrin - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual, open-air music festival that takes place over five days in the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. In 1985, American vocal virtuoso Bobby McFerrin took the stage solo at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: Spiral
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Ochun Chucho
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Episode 5: Chet Baker - Jazz Greats
programme.desc: American trumpet player and occasional singer Chet Baker (1929-1988) was one of the most popular exponents of bebop and cool jazz. At the age of 10, Baker was introduced to music in a school orchestra, after which he discovered bebop in the army in 1946. After serving six months in prison in 1953 for drug possession, Baker formed his own quartet with West Coast jazz great, pianist Russ Freeman.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Tony Bennett
programme.desc: Relive the magic of one of the most beloved crooners in music history in his prime: Tony Bennett! Recorded live in London’s Royal Albert Hall on March 2, 1974, this enchanting performance showcases Bennett's remarkable vocal prowess and charisma to full effect.

programme.title: McCoy Tyner Trio live at Estival Lugano
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. McCoy Tyner’s first main exposure came with Benny Golson, being the first pianist in Golson’s and Art Farmer’s Jazztet.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Ballad Of Ernie Washington
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Brussels Jazz Orchestra And Bert Joris - Big Valses
programme.desc: This might come unexpected, but the Brussels Jazz Orchestra (BJO) is not the kind of jazz orchestra that sticks to standards. They prefer to achieve the highest level by composing original music, creating unique arrangements, and playing inventively as well as passionately. In fact, it really is jazz with a dynamic orchestral sound, with a classic strength in which each musician is also a brilliant soloist.

programme.title: Song for my Father
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: World-renowned American blues singer and guitarist Magic Slim performed an electrifying set at the French festival Jazz à Vienne 2012. With bandmates John McDonald (guitar And vocals), Andre Howard (bass), and Brian Jones (drums), the blues giant played a string of classic Chicago blues hits. Ever energetic, the veritable blues veteran put on a dynamic show for an enthusiastic audience in the atmospheric ancient Roman theatre of Vienne.

programme.title: On Piano
programme.desc: Jazz first gained a foothold on Latvian soil in the 1920s. A century onward, this documentary traces the first two decades of jazz in Latvia in this portrait of Jack Michalicky, the first known Latvian jazz pianist. Michalicky was a musician from head to toe – a gifted violinist, he truly felt at home at the piano. Slender and lithe, the imaginative pianist’s fingers flew across the keys like a true miracle.

programme.title: Branford Marsalis Quartet - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, jazz saxophonist Branford Marsalis brought his band to the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Live in London 2013
programme.desc: ITunes Festival, is an annual music festival that takes place over a month in London. Sponsored by Apple Inc., it had its first edition in 2007.

programme.title: Roy Hargrove Quintet
programme.desc: Emblematic trumpeter of the second wave of 'neo-boppers' that appeared at the end of the 80s in the wake of Wynton Marsalis, Roy Hargrove has established himself as one of the most talented and unpredictable of the lot.

programme.title: Sly Johnson And Nicholas V. - Tribute to Marvin Gaye
programme.desc: For 20 years, Sly Johnson, author, composer and performer of the Saïan Supa Crew, has been touring the French music scene with his soul, hip-hop and beat-box vocals. He leaves his machines in the studio for a tribute concert to one of the leading voices of the famous Motown label, Marvin Gaye. The singer was killed by his father, a pastor, the day before his 45th birthday.

programme.title: Betty Carter/Jazzmeia Horn, Please Do Something
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Dizzy Gillespie, Bebop
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron’s June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine’s Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet).

programme.title: Grégory Privat - SOLEY
programme.desc: Pianist Grégory Privat's 2020 work 'Soley' inhabits a hybrid universe in which voice, piano and synthesizer, Caribbean and electronic music, and the classical and jazz trio traditions coexist and mingle.

programme.title: Josh Evans - Pier One Import
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn’ at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, RAndB, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical.

programme.title: Marcus Miller: Thoughts on Miles
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited’ tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report’s “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine.

programme.title: H. Jones, J. Woode, C. Lucas - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: The Good Times
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Andre Marques - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The Da Pá Virada Sessions series presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the artists taking part in this series is pianist, composer, and arranger André Marques.

programme.title: Carla Bley Sextet live at Estival Lugano 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. Discover the special bond between pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow.

programme.title: Michelle David - Jazz in Duketown
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Bill Evans And The Spykillers
programme.desc: American jazz saxophonist and two-time Grammy nominee Bill Evans plays at the legendary Parisian nightclub New Morning with Wolfgang Haffner (drums), Gary Grainger (bass) and Simon Oslender (keys), collectively known as The Spykillers. Naturally, a Bill Evans concert would not be complete without the song ‘Jean Pierre’, a French nursery song Evans recorded during his tenure with Miles Davis’s band in the 1980s.

programme.title: Portrait of Roy Ayers
programme.desc: ‘The legend of the groove’ is a series of documentaries devoted to the musicians who were most influential on contemporary hip hop, soul, rhythm 'n' blues, and on the course of history. Between the late 1950s and now, these musicians radically changed music. Although sometimes hardly in the public eye, they have all been major sources of inspiration for today's major artists: Prince, Erykah Badu, Janis Joplin and Jimi Hendrix.

programme.title: If Only
programme.desc: Raul Midón appeared at 2017’s Sing Jazz Festival in Singapore with double bassist Romeir Mendez and drummer Billy Williams. Blind since birth, Raul Midón is a singer, guitarist, and songwriter from New Mexico. With a vocal range as dynamic as his guitar playing and a remarkable talent for trumpet mimicry, Midón’s performances transcend musical boundaries, effortlessly blending rock, jazz, folk, and Latin pop into his unique sound.

programme.title: Sarah Vaughan Live in '58 And 64: The Divine One
programme.desc: Sarah Vaughan: Live in '58 And 64 features the ‘Divine One’ in her prime, wrapping her sultry voice around jazz standards such as ‘Lover Man’, ‘Misty’ and ‘I Got Rhythm’ and soaring on popular showtunes such as ‘Over The Rainbow’ and ‘Maria’. One of the greatest voices of the 20th Century, her renditions of songs by Harold Arlen, Leonard Bernstein, Johnny Burke, the Gershwins and Stephen Sondheim are pure diva magic.

programme.title: O. Peterson Trio and S. Grappelli - Grand Gala
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s, the annual Grand Gala du Disque was the awards ceremony during which the Edison Awards were presented to Dutch and international artists. These prestigious events were landmarks in the history of Dutch music broadcasting.

programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: Give It to Him
programme.desc: Jazz in Duketown is the largest free outdoor jazz festival in the Netherlands. It's a real gathering for jazz addicts, inviting internationally renowned artists. The talented American singer Michelle David performs pop and gospel music that feeds the heart and soothes the soul. Having grown up with the church, she started singing at the age of four. A year later she joined her first band, The Mission of Love.

programme.title: Mike Stern And Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat And Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis’ comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation.

programme.title: Trevor Richards
programme.desc: English drummer Trevor Richards (1945) is a passionate advocate for traditional jazz. After moving to New Orleans at 21 to master the city's unique drumming styles, he has consistently created opportunities to perform with the genre's elder statesmen.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Straight No Chaser
programme.desc: The Newport Jazz Festival, first established in the North-American town of Newport, Rhode Island in the summer of 1954, has now grown to become one of the largest multi-day celebrations of jazz worldwide. It has resulted in numerous famous live albums from top-rate jazz stars, and has spawned several worldwide tours, including editions of the Newport Jazz Festival in Rotterdam, The Netherlands.

programme.title: The Tällberg Foundation: 'Jazz for the Planet'
programme.desc: On October 19, 2021, John Patitucci (bass), Marco Pignataro (sax and musical director), and Joe Lovano (sax) showcased inspirational new originals at GBH's Fraser Performance Studio in Boston, MA, accompanied by Terri Lyne Carrington (drums), Nadia Washington (vocals), Chico Pinheiro (guitar), and Anastassiya Petrova (piano).

programme.title: Hamilton e Laginha - Da Pá Virada Sessions
programme.desc: The series Da Pá Virada sessions presents the best musicians of contemporary Brazilian jazz, and beyond. Filmed in São Paulo, each session offers a unique experience by giving a fresh look into Brazil's music scene. The artists for each session are selected in consultation with Stingray DJAZZ's music editor. One of the bands taking part in this series is the duo of Hamilton and Laginha.

programme.title: Malta Jazz Festival
programme.desc: Vocalist Jazzmeia Horn’s 2019 Malta Jazz Festival appearance was a celebration of jazz’s future, infused with the soul of its past. Featuring Keith Brown (piano), Rashaan Carter (bass), Irwin Hall (flute and saxophone), and Anwar Marshall (drums), the young singer’s performance was a reminder of jazz’s enduring power to speak to the heart.

programme.title: I Own the Night
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: jazzahead! 2024
programme.desc: Annual trade fair, exhibition, and festival jazzahead! is one of the international jazz community’s most important events. Hosted in Bremen, Germany, jazzahead! brings together musicians, bookers, agents, organizers, jazz experts, and music enthusiasts at the world’s largest jazz event. In 2024, jazzahead!

programme.title: Casper the Funky Ghost: Bootsy Collins à Vienne
programme.desc: Bootsy Collins, famed for playing with George Clinton and his very own Rubber Band, is used to playing syncopated, hard and relentlessly rhythmic music. With this unique style Bootsy was a major influence on the development of funk. Now in his 60s, the bassist seems animated by a new energy that reflects his new work on the album ‘Tha Funk Capitol of the World’.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: SummerJazz Leiden
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Billie Holiday
programme.desc: “God Bless The Child”, “Foolin’ Myself”, and “I Loves You, Porgy”: timeless songs that were made classics by the inimitable Billie Holiday. ‘Lady Day’, as her loyal friend and musical partner Lester Young nicknamed her, was a highly original jazz and pop singer. In a career that spanned most of the 1930s, 1940s and 1950s, she displayed an uncanny ability to convey emotion through her voice.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Michael Brecker Band - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Anita Oday Live in Sweden 1963
programme.desc: Anita O’Day?boasts two wonderful concerts from 1963 and 1970 that present the “jazz singer supreme” in impeccable form. O’Day’s horn-based approach to singing is in full effect throughout both shows including stand-out renditions in each show of audience favorites “Tea For Two” and “Sweet Georgia Brown” (both reprised from her triumphant appearance at the 1958 Newport Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano.

programme.title: Tania Maria Trio - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: WCCB: Ben Whittaker vs. Liam Cameron II T2025 - Ep. 420
programme.desc: From Resorts World Arena in Birmingham, one of the top prospects in boxing, Olympic Silver Medalist Ben Whittaker, meets Liam Cameron in a highly anticipated light heavyweight rematch of their dramatic split draw last November. In their first meeting on the undercard of Beterbiev/Bivol from Saudi Arabia, Whittaker was unable to finish the bout when both fighters fell from the ring.

programme.title: Judo for the World T1 - Ep. 5
programme.desc: Judo for the World features the best competitors in the sport as they compete in a global tour for an opportunity to vie for the gold in the World Judo Championship. In this episode we see the best of the Judo Grand Prix from Antalya, speak with Lukas Krpalek about his move to +100 kg weight class, and get a demonstration on how to preform the popular ride and roll counter attack.

programme.title: KNOCKOUTS! T1 - Ep. 12
programme.desc: The main event in this episode is a light heavyweight championship contest featuring Bernard Hopkins and Jean Pascal meeting for a second time. Their original contest, just five months earlier, resulted in a controversial draw, and the WBC ordered a rematch. Also on the card, action from young heavyweight stud Deontay Wilder.

programme.title: FS Grand Sumo T12 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: For the first time the top ranked sumo competitors in the world are featured in an action packed series, FIGHT SPORTS GRAND SUMO. This new format presents Sumo in an authentic, in-depth and entertaining way covering the rules, ranks, match-ups, and more. Show 3 featuring Hakuho, Daieisho, Kaisei and Ichinojo from the Hatsu basho, 2018.

programme.title: Prison Fighters T1 - Ep. 1
programme.desc: This series follows former Muay Thai champion Noy Khaopan and American Cody Moberly, two inmates in a Thailand prison, who after seven years are given the chance to fight for their release. By joining a controversial government modern day Prison Fight program, murderers and felons are given the chance to fight for their freedom, and possible redemption, through the ancient tradition of Muay Thai matches. Episode 1 of 4.

programme.title: Wide World of Fights T3 - Ep. 6
programme.desc: This episode features Carlos Quintana's penultimate bout, as he fights Deandre Latimore, in a light middleweight title contest, as well as kickboxing, sumo and more!

programme.desc: BodogFIGHT features classic MMA matches involving some of your favorite fighters! Two females in the flyweight division Tara LaRosa meets Cody Welchlin in a fight that does not go the distance. A spectacular arm triangle cliches the victory for one woman in Trenton, NJ, USA.

programme.title: Les Disparus des Argonnes
programme.desc: Gilles Veyrades, jeune appelé effectuant son service militaire, disparaît mystérieusement alors qu’il devait rentrer en permission. Sa mère, Jocelyne, refuse de croire à une fugue ou à une désertion. Malgré l’indifférence des autorités, elle commence à interroger son entourage et découvre qu’il ne s’agit pas d’un cas isolé : d’autres appelés de la région se sont volatilisés sans explication.

programme.title: L'affaire d'outreau
programme.desc: Kevin, 10 ans, Dimitri, 8 ans, Jonathan, 6 ans et Dylan, 4 ans, les garçons de la famille Delay, ont été placés en famille d'accueil en raison d'épisodes de violence de la part de leur père. En sécurité auprès de leur 'tata', ils révèlent que leurs parents, ainsi que des habitants de la Tour du Renard à Outreau, abusent régulièrement d'eux.

programme.title: Samy et les Anges de la Timone
programme.desc: INFRAROUGE Eglantine Emeyé a perdu, au mois de février dernier, son fils Samy, lourdement handicapé depuis sa naissance. Samy était arrivé dans le service de neuro-pédiatrie de l’hôpital de la Timone, quelques jours avant, suite à des complications d’une opération du dos.

programme.title: La Machine à Écrire et autres Sources de Tracas
programme.desc: L’idée de filmer une, puis deux, puis trois « V.A.D. », comme disent les soignants pour « visites à domicile », s’est naturellement imposée : elles permettent d’étoffer certains personnages, de les singulariser. Au-delà, il semble important de montrer que l’Adamant n’est pas une entité repliée sur elle-même, fonctionnant en vase clos, puisque c’est tout le contraire.

programme.title: Présence Protestante
programme.desc: Pour les 100 ans du Palais de la Femme, Écriture. s rend hommage à Blanche Peyron, son opiniâtre fondatrice, officier de l'Armée du Salut. Marion Muller-Colard reçoit Marie-Laure Marshall, auteure de la bande-dessinée Blanche, une victorieuse – Naissance d’une armée contre la misère (Bibli’O) et Laetitia Colombani parle de son livre Les Victorieuses (Grasset).

programme.title: A l'origine Histoires 2026
programme.desc: Frank Lalou est calligraphe, et il est surtout passionné par le sens des lettres. Grâce à son art, il explore la dimension spirituelle et mystique des 22 lettres de l’alphabet hébraïque. Des lettres qui s’enchaînent et sont comme des chemins de vie. Son souffle accompagne chacun de ses gestes comme une inspiration du Souffle Divin.

programme.title: Ici Matin

programme.desc: Qu’est-ce que la pollution sonore ? Et quelle est son origine ? Comment la calculer ? Et que faire contre le bruit ? Quel impact a cette pollution sonore sur les humains et sur les animaux ? Voilà toutes les questions auxquelles vont répondre Max, Mathieu et Cécile. Cécile va se rendre chez Bruitparif, un observatoire du bruit en Île-de-France pour mieux comprendre quelles sont les sources du bruit et comment lutter contre.

programme.title: Reparer les Vivants
programme.desc: Réalisé par Katell Quillévéré Avec Tahar Rahim, Emmanuelle Seigner, Anne Dorval Un événement dévastateur va mêler la vie d'un adolescent malheureux, d'une femme souffrant d'une maladie cardiaque et une équipe de médecins compatissants: tous sont de parfaits inconnus, parfaitement interconnectés...

programme.title: Misery
programme.desc: Réalisé par Rob Reiner Avec James Caan, Kathy Bates, Richard Farnsworth, Lauren Bacall Après avoir consacré plusieurs romans au personnage de Misery, Paul Sheldon décide de mettre un terme à son histoire en la faisant mourir. Heureux d'en avoir fini avec cette héroïne, il quitte l'hôtel de montagne où il écrit habituellement afin de rejoindre New York.

programme.title: Rachelle allison a la Cigale
programme.desc: Production: BCI Communication - Frédéric Tyrode Saint Louis Réalisation: Arnaud Legoff Rachelle Allison est une artiste guadeloupéenne, originaire de Basse-Terre. Passionnée de musique et de chant depuis son plus jeune âge, ses influences musicales sont diverses : rythm and blues, reggae, dancehall et le rap. Après quelques années dans l’hexagone pour ses études, Rachelle rentre en Guadeloupe pour vivre sa passion.

programme.title: Planète Rap, la Quotidienne
programme.desc: Fred Musa interroge un artiste urbain sur son rapport au rap.

programme.title: Barth à la Cigale
programme.desc: Une production : BCI Communication Réalisation : Arnaud Legoff Capté à la Cigale de Paris le 27 février 2026. Issu d'une famille d'artistes, Barth, de son vrai nom Rudy Ichane Moimbe, baigne très tôt dans la musique, qui devient le socle de son identité. À 8 ans, il intègre le conservatoire de Saint-Benoît, où il se forme à la guitare et pose les premières bases d'un univers déjà singulier.

programme.title: Billie Eilish, sa French Story
programme.desc: Un film de Claire Duguet et Yasmina Jaafri Coécrit avec Michka Assayas Production : Une prod à soi et Slo Slo avec la participation de France Télévisions C’est à Paris que ce film se situe pour raconter le lien fort entre Billie Eilish et la France… Sa French Story ! Nourri de témoignages et d’archives rares de l’artiste à Paris, mais aussi de nombreux extraits de ses vidéoclips, ce film est un voyage original et inédit !

programme.title: Notre Sacre
programme.desc: Le Sacre du printemps de Stravinski est une partition phare de la modernité, une œuvre clé dans son retentissement artistique, que ce soit chez les musiciens ou chez les chorégraphes. 111 ans après sa création mémorable, Blanca Li, Abd al Malik et David Grimal en proposent une nouvelle relecture, qui met l’accent sur son universalité et son actualité. En 1913, déjà, Le Sacre du printemps faisait œuvre de pleine conscience.

programme.desc: Un film de Céline Destève Production : Caroline Omond et Jean-Luc Orabona Un documentaire produit par Eclectic avec la participation de France Télévisions. 2025 Ce n’est un secret pour personne : dans le Sud-Ouest, la gastronomie rime avec art de vivre. Les traditions et les saveurs de cette région au caractère bien trempé et à l’accent chantant se perpétuent depuis des siècles.

programme.title: Mere Nature
programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Plimsoll Productions. 2022. Producteur de la série : Seb Ellis. Cette série dresse le portrait intime de mères du monde animal se battant au quotidien pour leur survie et celle de leurs petits, qu’elles soient de simples proies ou des prédatrices. Dans la réserve nationale du Masai Mara, chaque mère a ses propres combats. Les destins de plusieurs mères se croisent pour le meilleur comme pour le pire.

programme.desc: Série documentaire produite par Tony Comiti Productions, avec la participation de France télévisions. 2023. Réalisation : Antoine Boddaert et Guillaume Lhotellier. Pour eux, franchir ces routes de l'impossible est le seul moyen de gagner de quoi subsister.

programme.desc: ISTO É O POVO A FALAR' é um programa de entrevista e reportagem que aborda assuntos controversos e atuais vividos na sociedade portuguesa. Trata-se de um programa feito a pensar no Povo Português, em prol da sua dignidade e da proteção dos seus direitos enquanto cidadãos.'.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 8
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: A Rota T9 - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Vidas Transformadas T4 - Ep. 22
programme.desc: Vidas Transformadas é um programa baseado em testemunhos reais do que Deus está a fazer na vida das pessoas.

programme.title: Política And Religião - Ep. 19
programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.
